jobs.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
jobs.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: RevOps Analyst
jobs.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented RevOps Analyst to support and scale Sprinto’s outbound pipeline through high-quality market research, data enrichment, CRM management, account prioritization, and GTM operations. The role combines market and prospect research with hands-on GTM Operations, giving the candidate ownership across account and contact intelligence, signals and scoring, data quality, lead routing, CRM processes, and outbound infrastructure. The ideal candidate has experience in Market Research, Sales Research, or MRE roles, along with an interest in expanding into RevOps and GTM systems. They should be comfortable working with enrichment platforms, CRM systems, routing logic, account prioritization, automation workflows, and data governance. Where you'll leave your mark?: Conduct primary and secondary research to identify ICP-fit accounts and contacts across target industries and geographies. Build and maintain high-quality outbound databases with accurate, complete, and campaign-ready contact information. Source and enrich account and contact data using Clay/Bitscale/Cargo, Apollo/ZoomInfo/Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , and similar platforms. Research and map buying groups, personas, and relevant stakeholders within target accounts. Identify and capture relevant account and contact signals that indicate ICP fit, buying intent, business change, or sales opportunity. Develop and maintain account and contact scoring and prioritization frameworks to help Sales teams focus on the highest-value opportunities. Segment and prioritize accounts and contacts based on ICP criteria, signals, persona, employee size, geography, revenue, technology stack, and other relevant attributes. Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand pipeline and coverage requirements and ensure sales teams have a sufficient supply of qualified, prioritized accounts and contacts . Design and optimize data enrichment and automation workflows to improve data coverage, accuracy, and scalability. Maintain HubSpot CRM hygiene , including data validation, field standardization, lifecycle stages, ownership, and regular audits. Identify, manage, and eliminate duplicate accounts and contacts. Support lead, contact, and account routing based on territory, persona, employee size, geography, account ownership, and other GTM criteria. Audit routing and assignment outputs to identify incorrect ownership, unassigned records, duplicates, and other data issues. Support the implementation and maintenance of lead and account assignment logic in HubSpot. Assist with CRM data governance, segmentation, enrichment, and operational workflows. Monitor account coverage and identify gaps in target account and contact coverage , proactively addressing them through research and enrichment. Collaborate with SDRs, AEs, Marketing and RevOps teams to troubleshoot data and operational issues. Support GTM Operations projects involving CRM workflows, automation, enrichment, routing, scoring, prioritization, and data orchestration . The kind of builder we're looking for -: 2–3 years of experience in Market Research, Market Research Executive (MRE), GTM Engineering, Sales Research, or similar roles. Strong hands-on experience with account and contact research, ICP identification, persona mapping, and prospect data sourcing . Experience with tools such as Clay, Bitscale, Cargo, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , or similar enrichment and prospecting platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills are required. Working knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM . Understanding of CRM data hygiene, deduplication, enrichment, segmentation, and data governance. Understanding of account scoring, signal-based prioritization, and lead/account qualification is preferred. Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets while maintaining data accuracy. Ability to translate business requirements into structured data, processes, scoring frameworks, and operational workflows . Ability to work with Sales and Marketing teams to understand account coverage requirements and translate them into actionable research and data programs . Interest in RevOps, GTM systems, automation, and sales technology . Basic understanding of automation, APIs, or scripting such as JavaScript is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-oriented mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with Sales, SDR, Marketing, and RevOps teams. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

jobs.title: GTM AI Operations - India
jobs.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" #LI-Remote #BI-Remote

Analyze sales performance metrics, including win/loss trends, funnel conversion, and pipeline development, to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and implement AI agents, skills, and workflows to improve the efficiency of data analysis, reporting, and process development within Revenue Operations. Contribute to initiatives that improve commercial productivity and effectiveness, including lead routing, pipeline generation, and sales process optimization. needs_verification.title: Marketing Operations & AI Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Data quality and CRM management Maintain and optimize contact, account, and lead data across HubSpot and Salesforce. Identify the root causes of data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and incorrect field mappings, implementing sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues. Develop AI-powered workflows for data enrichment, deduplication, validation, and cleanup to reduce manual effort and improve data reliability. Marketing and campaign attribution Own campaign attribution from the first customer interaction through closed-won opportunities, ensuring accurate tracking across marketing activities. Maintain reliable campaign tracking processes that provide visibility into pipeline generation and marketing performance. Build and maintain reports that translate marketing data into actionable insights, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about resource allocation and campaign investments. Prospect list building and enrichment Build, maintain, and enrich targeted prospect lists using Clay and TitanX, aligned with the ideal customer profile (ICP) and strategic target accounts. Ensure prospect lists are accurate, relevant, deduplicated, and ready for sales outreach. Continuously improve list-building workflows to increase prospecting efficiency and data quality. Process improvement and AI automation Identify repetitive manual tasks and replace them with AI agents, automated workflows, custom assistants, or lightweight tools. Use AI technologies to streamline data management, research, analysis, list generation, and operational processes. Investigate problems independently, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements without waiting for detailed instructions. Document processes, CRM fields, workflow changes, and operating procedures, communicating updates clearly to relevant stakeholders. Business development operations Develop reports tracking business development representative (BDR) activity, including calls, emails, contact engagement, and outreach performance. Determine which prospect lists should be prioritized for outreach and load qualified contacts into appropriate Outreach sequences. Monitor BDR workloads, assigned tasks, and sequence capacity to ensure balanced workloads and effective prospect engagement. Identify and address operational issues early, including declining list availability, incomplete activities, underperforming sequences, and gaps in outreach execution. Collaborate with marketing and sales stakeholders to improve operational alignment, pipeline visibility, and overall revenue generation. Requirements: At least 3 years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations, or revenue operations within a B2B organization. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to identify data inconsistencies, duplicate records, broken integrations, and campaign tracking issues before they affect business performance. A solid understanding of commercial objectives and the ability to connect operational reporting with business decisions, pipeline generation, and revenue outcomes. Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models, campaign tracking, and performance reporting. Proficiency in working with large datasets and spreadsheets, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data validation, and data cleanup. Experience supporting BDR or sales development representative (SDR) teams through reporting, prospect list building, contact enrichment, and outreach sequencing. Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement platforms, particularly HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach. Experience with Clay and TitanX is also relevant. Practical experience using AI tools beyond basic conversational assistance, including building AI agents, custom assistants, automated workflows, or multi-step processes that improve operational efficiency. Ability to identify opportunities for automation, experiment with emerging AI tools, and implement solutions that eliminate repetitive manual work. needs_verification.title: Product Enablement Specialist II
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Mobile App Lifecycle Management: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications throughout onboarding, development coordination, store submission, launch, and ongoing updates. App Store Submissions: Prepare, submit, and maintain applications on Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console, ensuring compliance with platform requirements and submission guidelines. Rejection Investigation and Resolution: Analyze app review rejections from Apple and Google, identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and coordinate resubmissions to minimize launch delays. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex issues involving developer accounts, app builds, metadata, configurations, permissions, certificates, provisioning, API keys, and submission workflows before escalating to Engineering. Proactive Blocker Management: Identify applications experiencing submission delays or stalled progress, determine the next required actions, and proactively coordinate solutions to keep projects moving. Customer Support and Escalation Management: Handle complex customer cases, conduct troubleshooting calls when necessary, and provide clear, practical guidance to customers and agency owners. Developer Account Guidance: Help agency owners navigate Apple Developer Program requirements, Google Play Console configurations, account verification, agreements, access permissions, and application transfers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, communicate relevant findings, validate fixes, and ensure that reported issues are resolved effectively. Mobile App Testing and Validation: Perform end-to-end testing of mobile app workflows and verify that technical fixes, configurations, and updates work as expected before proceeding with submissions or releases. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document recurring app rejection scenarios, troubleshooting procedures, and successful resolutions to improve internal knowledge resources and operational consistency. Team Enablement: Support Product Enablement Specialist I team members by answering process-related questions, sharing troubleshooting expertise, and helping them resolve application issues more efficiently. Operational Improvement: Identify recurring technical and operational challenges, recommend process improvements, and contribute to reducing repeated submission failures and unnecessary escalations. Performance and Reporting: Maintain accurate application records, monitor progress across assigned apps, prepare operational reports, and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs). Requirements: Professional Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, application support, or a related field. Apple App Ecosystem: Working knowledge of the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, iOS application submission procedures, and app review requirements. Google Play Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google Play Console, Android app submission processes, developer account management, and store compliance requirements. App Submission Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to investigate app review rejections, submission blockers, configuration problems, and account-related issues independently. Mobile Application Fundamentals: Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Notification Services: Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), or comparable mobile notification technologies. Developer Account Administration: Ability to manage account access, user permissions, agreements, verification requirements, and app transfers across Apple and Google platforms. Technical Investigation: Ability to diagnose build, configuration, access, and submission issues before escalating them to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON and configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Testing and Quality Assurance: Ability to validate technical fixes and conduct end-to-end testing to ensure mobile applications function correctly throughout critical workflows. Data Analysis and Reporting: Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions to complex problems. Customer Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable explanations for customers and non-technical stakeholders. Ownership and Independence: A proactive mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex issues with limited supervision. Organization and Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple applications and customer cases simultaneously, prioritize urgent blockers, and meet deadlines and SLA requirements. Collaboration and Mentoring: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with customers, agency owners, Product and Engineering teams, and junior specialists. Continuous Improvement: A willingness to document new findings, share knowledge, improve workflows, and help reduce recurring operational issues. Preferred Experience: Previous experience with a SaaS or CRM platform, particularly white-label mobile app solutions, is beneficial. Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools is also an advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility of a distributed working environment. Career Development: Build specialized expertise in mobile app publishing, technical troubleshooting, SaaS operations, and product enablement. Technical Growth: Gain hands-on experience with Apple and Google developer ecosystems, mobile application configurations, notification services, and app lifecycle management. Increased Ownership: Independently manage complex application portfolios and take responsibility for technical problem-solving and customer outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and improve application workflows. Reporting and Analytics: Create, update, and maintain recurring and ad hoc recruitment reports to track key hiring metrics, provide operational insights, and support informed decision-making by talent acquisition teams and business stakeholders. Data Auditing and Quality Control: Conduct regular data audits, identify discrepancies or missing information, coordinate necessary corrections, and follow up on outstanding issues until they are resolved. ATS Administration: Support the administration and maintenance of the recruitment platform, including job postings, openings, templates, application forms, workflows, and other system configurations. Recruitment Process Management: Help develop, maintain, and document standardized recruitment processes and workflows, ensuring that recruiters and hiring teams follow established procedures consistently. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure required recruitment information is captured accurately and on time, supporting smooth execution throughout the hiring lifecycle. System Testing and Implementation: Assist with testing and implementing system enhancements, workflow changes, and new recruitment processes to ensure functionality, accuracy, and operational readiness. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve recruitment data quality, streamline administrative processes, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance the overall effectiveness of talent acquisition operations. Interview Scheduling Support: Provide interview coordination and scheduling assistance when required, based on team workload and operational coverage needs. Project and Program Support: Contribute to recruitment-related projects, talent acquisition programs, and cross-functional initiatives that support business growth and operational excellence. Global Team Coordination: Maintain effective communication with US-based colleagues and other stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-ups, accurate information sharing, and continuity of recruiting operations across time zones. Requirements: Professional Experience: 2–3 years of experience in talent acquisition operations, recruiting operations, HR operations, or a similar administrative or operational role. Applicant Tracking Systems: Hands-on experience using an applicant tracking system, including maintaining recruitment data, supporting workflows, and ensuring data accuracy. Experience with Ashby is strongly preferred. Recruitment Reporting: Experience creating and maintaining recruitment reports, tracking key performance indicators, and working with hiring data to support operational decisions. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams, with the ability to manage data, prepare reports, and coordinate effectively with stakeholders. Prepare, submit, and manage applications across the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, ensuring compliance with platform requirements. Investigate and resolve application rejections, submission blockers, developer account issues, build failures, metadata problems, configuration errors, and access-related challenges. Identify applications experiencing delays or stalled progress and proactively determine the appropriate next steps to move them forward. Handle complex customer cases and lead troubleshooting calls when necessary, translating technical issues into clear and actionable guidance. Guide agency owners through Apple Developer and Google Play Console requirements, including account setup, permissions, agreements, verification, and app transfers. Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, providing relevant diagnostic information and validating solutions before closing issues. Document new rejection scenarios, troubleshooting methods, and successful resolutions to strengthen team knowledge and consistency. Support Product Enablement Specialist I colleagues by answering process questions and sharing technical troubleshooting expertise. Identify recurring operational challenges and recommend improvements to workflows, documentation, and submission processes. Maintain service-level agreement (SLA) compliance, accurate application tracking, and reliable reporting across the assigned portfolio. Perform end-to-end testing of mobile application workflows and verify fixes to ensure successful outcomes. Requirements: Typically 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, or a related technical or customer-facing role. Working knowledge of Apple Developer, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and iOS and Android application submission processes. Experience troubleshooting application review rejections, submission failures, and related technical blockers. Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Ability to manage developer account access, permissions, agreements, verification processes, and application transfers. Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging, or comparable mobile notification technologies. Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Ability to investigate build, configuration, account, and submission issues independently before escalating to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON, configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting capabilities, and sound judgment when managing complex technical issues. Experience managing customer escalations and handling multiple applications or cases simultaneously with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical problems and solutions clearly to non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, organization, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Familiarity with the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, app review management, or SaaS and CRM platforms is preferred. Experience with HighLevel or similar platforms, as well as AI-powered productivity tools, is an added advantage. Benefits: Remote work arrangement within India. Opportunity to develop expertise in mobile application publishing, platform compliance, and technical troubleshooting across iOS and Android. needs_verification.title: Performance Marketing Apprentice
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Support the performance marketing team with day-to-day campaign reporting, data analysis, and paid media operations. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports across digital advertising channels, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads. Use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to organize, clean, analyze, and present campaign data. Monitor key marketing metrics, including advertising spend, impressions, clicks, click-through rates (CTR), cost per click (CPC), leads, conversions, and cost per acquisition (CPA). Maintain marketing dashboards, reporting spreadsheets, campaign trackers, and performance documentation. Assist with campaign quality assurance before and after launch by checking tracking links, landing pages, UTM parameters, creative assets, and campaign settings. Support campaign setup, monitoring, and performance reviews across paid media platforms. Identify basic trends, performance changes, and anomalies in campaign data, escalating findings when necessary. Assist with keyword, audience, competitor, and market research to support campaign planning and optimization. Review search terms, advertising placements, audience performance, and campaign-level reports under the guidance of experienced team members. Help maintain campaign naming conventions, tracking documentation, creative libraries, landing page links, and advertising assets. Document campaign changes, experiments, optimization activities, and key learnings to support continuous improvement. Use ChatGPT and other AI-powered tools to support research, reporting, documentation, campaign ideation, and workflow efficiency. Collaborate with creative, analytics, web, and marketing operations teams to coordinate tasks and support campaign execution. Communicate progress, priorities, questions, and potential blockers clearly while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Learn new marketing tools, advertising platforms, reporting processes, and customer acquisition strategies while contributing to ongoing team initiatives. Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed coursework in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. Demonstrated interest in performance marketing, digital advertising, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or customer acquisition. Basic understanding of digital marketing principles, the customer acquisition funnel, and common campaign performance metrics. Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, with the ability to organize and work with numerical data. Familiarity with spreadsheet formulas, filters, pivot tables, charts, reporting, or data visualization is an advantage. Exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, Google Analytics, or similar digital marketing platforms is beneficial but not mandatory. Basic understanding of UTM tracking, campaign URLs, landing pages, and conversion tracking is an advantage. Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, documentation, or productivity is preferred. Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to reviewing data, reports, and campaign configurations. A proactive, self-motivated attitude, with the initiative to find resources, learn independently, ask questions, and take accountability. Ability to follow instructions, document processes, incorporate feedback, and seek clarification when needed. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share findings and provide clear status updates. Good collaboration, time-management, and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Curiosity about digital advertising, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and data-driven marketing optimization. Willingness to learn new tools and processes, take on challenging assignments, and work collaboratively in a remote environment. Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM India Standard Time (IST). Benefits: Monthly stipend: ₹40,000 INR for the duration of the six-month apprenticeship. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with no requirement to work from a physical office. Practical industry experience: Gain hands-on exposure to paid media campaigns, performance reporting, campaign tracking, and digital marketing operations. Professional development: Learn from an experienced performance marketing team and develop practical skills in campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization. Technology exposure: Build familiarity with leading digital advertising platforms, spreadsheets, analytics tools, and AI-powered workflows. Portfolio-building opportunities: Develop transferable skills and practical experience that can support future career opportunities in digital marketing and analytics. Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and learn how different marketing functions contribute to campaign performance and business growth. Structured apprenticeship: Participate in a six-month learning experience designed to build foundational skills and prepare you for further growth in performance marketing. needs_verification.title: Quality Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Maintain awareness of applicable GxP guidelines and regulatory requirements, ensuring that quality processes and service delivery activities remain compliant with established standards. Support and coordinate electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) activities, including change control, deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and effectiveness checks. Develop, recommend, monitor, and document deviations, quality events, and corrective and preventive actions, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis and effective resolution. Review, approve, and communicate root cause investigation findings and CAPA plans to relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear documentation and accountability. Conduct effectiveness checks to verify that corrective and preventive actions have addressed identified issues and reduced the likelihood of recurrence. Participate in GxP change management activities, including risk and impact assessments, change plan reviews and approvals, implementation monitoring, and tracking actions through completion. Coordinate client audits and regulatory inspections, including preparing agendas, organizing required documentation, arranging logistics, and ensuring relevant subject matter experts are available. Coordinate audit-related CAPA responses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to prepare accurate, comprehensive, and timely responses. Maintain audit and inspection records in the eQMS, ensuring that documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately stored, and tracked through closure. Generate quality reports and analyze data related to deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to quality systems, procedures, and operational processes. For medical information quality assurance activities, retrospectively evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to verify compliance with applicable procedures and quality standards. Collaborate with internal teams, quality stakeholders, and clients to support continuous improvement, strengthen compliance, and maintain high service quality. Undertake additional quality-related responsibilities as needed to support evolving business and operational requirements. Requirements A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in a suitable discipline is required. At least 2 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance role. Working knowledge of GxP quality management systems and the regulatory requirements applicable to quality-related activities. Experience with quality management processes, including deviations, quality events, CAPAs, effectiveness checks, and change control, is preferred. Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including quality record management, documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Strong understanding of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. Excellent organizational, prioritization, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage several activities and deadlines simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, internal teams, management, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong customer service skills and a collaborative approach to resolving quality issues and supporting internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining proactive, flexible, and responsive to changing priorities. A professional attitude, openness to change, and the ability to contribute positively to a diverse, collaborative, and quality-driven environment. Preferred: Experience conducting Medical Information Quality Assurance reviews, particularly evaluating recorded telephone calls and case reports in a call center environment. Benefits Flexible working arrangements: Remote working opportunities in India, with potential hybrid arrangements for employees located within a reasonable commuting distance of an office, as agreed with their manager. Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in quality assurance, GxP compliance, quality management systems, and regulatory processes. Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to support quality and compliance activities that contribute to reliable healthcare and pharmaceutical services. Collaborative environment: Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and clients on quality improvement initiatives. Continuous learning: Exposure to audits, regulatory inspections, quality investigations, and process improvement activities. Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where employees can contribute authentically and develop their skills. Career growth: Opportunities to expand quality assurance expertise and take on additional responsibilities as business needs evolve. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? needs_verification.title: PPC Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: As a PPC Specialist, you will oversee the end-to-end management of paid media campaigns, combining strategic planning, hands-on execution, and performance optimization to achieve marketing and business goals. Campaign strategy and planning: Define campaign objectives, KPIs, audience targeting, budget allocations, and bidding strategies. Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Campaign setup and execution: Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and relevant social media platforms, including search, display, shopping, and remarketing campaigns. Ad creation and testing: Develop compelling ad copy, organize campaign structures, and test different creative variations, extensions, audiences, and messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates. Performance monitoring and optimization: Track key metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), impressions, and conversions. Adjust bids, budgets, and targeting based on performance insights. Conversion rate optimization: Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to improve landing pages, forms, messaging, and user journeys. Use analytics and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for higher conversion rates. Tracking and analytics: Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking, UTM parameters, advertising pixels, Google Analytics, and tag management systems to ensure reliable measurement and reporting. Reporting and insights: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports, analyze attribution and funnel performance, and present actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Budget management and forecasting: Monitor advertising spend, maintain budget pacing, and forecast traffic, leads, conversions, and ROI using historical data and market trends. Cross-functional collaboration: Share performance insights and best practices across marketing channels, ensuring paid media activities align with SEO, content, and broader digital marketing initiatives. Continuous improvement: Stay informed about advertising platform updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies. Test new channels, formats, tools, and automation opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scalability. Requirements We are looking for an analytical, proactive, and results-oriented digital marketing professional with hands-on PPC experience, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to translate campaign data into effective optimization strategies. A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing PPC and paid media campaigns. Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, including search, display, and remarketing campaigns. Experience with Google Analytics, tag management systems, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make evidence-based decisions. Excellent written communication and ad-copywriting skills, with an understanding of how messaging influences engagement and conversions. Familiarity with landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize competing tasks, and meet deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and present insights to stakeholders. Curiosity and adaptability, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with digital advertising developments. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, or other paid media platforms. Familiarity with e-commerce and shopping campaigns. Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordStream, Optimizely, or Unbounce. Exposure to automated bidding strategies, advertising scripts, or API-based campaign management. Knowledge of attribution models, multi-touch attribution, and advanced marketing analytics. Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications. Benefits 100% remote work: Work from anywhere, subject to the role's location requirements. Competitive salary: Receive a competitive compensation package. Inclusive work environment: Join a supportive workplace that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. Career growth opportunities: Develop your expertise and progress professionally within digital marketing. strong_shortlist.title: Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist
strong_shortlist.description: Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies. We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one. Summary: We are seeking a highly detail-oriented Salesforce Operations & Data Quality Specialist to support the integrity, accuracy, and scalability of our licensing and renewal operations. This role will serve as the operational owner for data quality monitoring, exception management, account maintenance, and customer record cleanup across Salesforce and Atlassian PPC systems. What you will do:: Monitor Salesforce error queues and exception-tracking objects. Review and triage data-related issues impacting renewals and licensing processes. Perform manual data corrections to ensure record accuracy and completeness. Identify and remediate duplicate, missing, incomplete, and mismatched renewal records. Maintain account alias mappings for customer-name variations and account matching. Manage customer and billing-profile cleanup efforts across all Cprime accounts within Atlassian PPC. Escalate confirmed system defects and complex issues to the Licensing Technical team with clear documentation. Report on recurring issues, data cleanup progress, trends, and operational metrics. Recommend process improvements that increase data accuracy and reduce manual effort. Required Skills & Qualifications:: 1+ years of experience in Salesforce Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data Quality, Business Operations, or a related field. Experience working with Salesforce data management, reporting, and record maintenance. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Track record of building executive-level relationships and influencing multiple stakeholders across business and technology organizations Excellent presentation, communication, and executive facilitation skills. Preferred Skills (Good to Have):: Experience supporting SaaS, licensing, subscription, or renewal operations. Familiarity with Atlassian products and licensing environments. Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience. What We Believe In At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

strong_shortlist.title: RevOps Analyst
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented RevOps Analyst to support and scale Sprinto’s outbound pipeline through high-quality market research, data enrichment, CRM management, account prioritization, and GTM operations. The role combines market and prospect research with hands-on GTM Operations, giving the candidate ownership across account and contact intelligence, signals and scoring, data quality, lead routing, CRM processes, and outbound infrastructure. The ideal candidate has experience in Market Research, Sales Research, or MRE roles, along with an interest in expanding into RevOps and GTM systems. They should be comfortable working with enrichment platforms, CRM systems, routing logic, account prioritization, automation workflows, and data governance. Where you'll leave your mark?: Conduct primary and secondary research to identify ICP-fit accounts and contacts across target industries and geographies. Build and maintain high-quality outbound databases with accurate, complete, and campaign-ready contact information. Source and enrich account and contact data using Clay/Bitscale/Cargo, Apollo/ZoomInfo/Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , and similar platforms. Research and map buying groups, personas, and relevant stakeholders within target accounts. Identify and capture relevant account and contact signals that indicate ICP fit, buying intent, business change, or sales opportunity. Develop and maintain account and contact scoring and prioritization frameworks to help Sales teams focus on the highest-value opportunities. Segment and prioritize accounts and contacts based on ICP criteria, signals, persona, employee size, geography, revenue, technology stack, and other relevant attributes. Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to understand pipeline and coverage requirements and ensure sales teams have a sufficient supply of qualified, prioritized accounts and contacts . Design and optimize data enrichment and automation workflows to improve data coverage, accuracy, and scalability. Maintain HubSpot CRM hygiene , including data validation, field standardization, lifecycle stages, ownership, and regular audits. Identify, manage, and eliminate duplicate accounts and contacts. Support lead, contact, and account routing based on territory, persona, employee size, geography, account ownership, and other GTM criteria. Audit routing and assignment outputs to identify incorrect ownership, unassigned records, duplicates, and other data issues. Support the implementation and maintenance of lead and account assignment logic in HubSpot. Assist with CRM data governance, segmentation, enrichment, and operational workflows. Monitor account coverage and identify gaps in target account and contact coverage , proactively addressing them through research and enrichment. Collaborate with SDRs, AEs, Marketing and RevOps teams to troubleshoot data and operational issues. Support GTM Operations projects involving CRM workflows, automation, enrichment, routing, scoring, prioritization, and data orchestration . The kind of builder we're looking for -: 2–3 years of experience in Market Research, Market Research Executive (MRE), GTM Engineering, Sales Research, or similar roles. Strong hands-on experience with account and contact research, ICP identification, persona mapping, and prospect data sourcing . Experience with tools such as Clay, Bitscale, Cargo, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator , or similar enrichment and prospecting platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills are required. Working knowledge of HubSpot or another CRM . Understanding of CRM data hygiene, deduplication, enrichment, segmentation, and data governance. Understanding of account scoring, signal-based prioritization, and lead/account qualification is preferred. Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets while maintaining data accuracy. Ability to translate business requirements into structured data, processes, scoring frameworks, and operational workflows . Ability to work with Sales and Marketing teams to understand account coverage requirements and translate them into actionable research and data programs . Interest in RevOps, GTM systems, automation, and sales technology . Basic understanding of automation, APIs, or scripting such as JavaScript is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-oriented mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with Sales, SDR, Marketing, and RevOps teams. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

strong_shortlist.title: GTM AI Operations - India
strong_shortlist.description: This opportunity requires that you work a specific shift as this is a region specific role. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. What You'll Be Doing:: Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity. Core Objectives:: Build Agentic Outbound Systems Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration. Operationalize AI at Scale Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools. Improve Outbound Efficiency Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability. Accelerate Pipeline Generation Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Ship Fast and Iterate Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact. We're Looking For:: A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals. Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity. Required Qualifications:: GTM Systems & Operations Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms. Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management. In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency. AI & Automation Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation. Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems. Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes. Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus. Builder Mentality Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration. Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly. Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale. Cross-Functional Collaboration Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Operating Style Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve. Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact. Shift Availability:: This role will align with an EMEA shift schedule, roughy 1:00pm - 10:00 pm IST #LI-YA1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role. Language: JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud®? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. strong_shortlist.title: Revenue Operations Analyst - Customer Experience & Partner Operations
strong_shortlist.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - Build the operating backbone for Customer Experience and Partnerships by ensuring our processes, systems, and data work together seamlessly. You’ll own the instrumentation of key workflows in HubSpot, establish reliable metrics and reporting, maintain operational hygiene, and turn GTM data into clear insights for the teams making decisions. The goal is simple: make CS and Partnerships easier to operate, easier to measure, and easier to scale. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own the Customer Success Operations including CX process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of CX processes, workflows and process adherence Owning of key metrics definition and periodic (Weekly, monthly, quarterly) reporting including renewal, retention, upsells, GDR, NDR, Logo retention Own the Partnership Operations including Partnership process instrumentation and CRM hygiene on Hubspot Documentation of Partnership processes, workflows and process adherence Build and maintain partner pipeline and program reporting Support recurring GTM operations requests across both CS and Partnerships including variable pay calculations, adhoc data requests The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3-5 years of experience in Revenue Operations preferably in Customer Success and/or Partnership Operations Hands-on experience with Hubspot including building workflows, properties, reports and dashboards Working fluency in SaaS metrics - ARR, MRR, GDR, NDR, Churn, Partner sourced and Partner influenced ARR Demonstrated experience in maintaining data hygiene and catching errors / process deviances Ability to learn new AI tools, technologies and processes Strong attention to detail and ability to collaborate effectively with various stakeholders How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Execute and optimize Deal Desk workflows, including structuring, reviewing, and approving non-standard deals in collaboration with Sales and Finance. Maintain CRM data quality, oversee field governance, and conduct regular audits to ensure accurate and reliable commercial data. Support revenue planning, reporting, and analysis related to territories, quotas, key performance indicators, and commercial performance across regions, segments, and verticals. Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports to monitor productivity, pipeline health, and overall commercial effectiveness. Analyze sales performance metrics, including win/loss trends, funnel conversion, and pipeline development, to identify opportunities for improvement. Develop and implement AI agents, skills, and workflows to improve the efficiency of data analysis, reporting, and process development within Revenue Operations. Contribute to initiatives that improve commercial productivity and effectiveness, including lead routing, pipeline generation, and sales process optimization. Support change management and enablement initiatives by developing training materials, documenting standard operating procedures, and facilitating the adoption of new processes. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and commercial leadership to translate business challenges into practical, data-driven solutions. Requirements: 2–4 years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations, or Go-to-Market Operations, ideally within a B2B SaaS environment. Demonstrated ability to design, improve, and implement scalable business processes and standard operating procedures. Familiarity with Salesforce, CPQ tools, and other go-to-market platforms, such as Salesloft, ZoomInfo, RingLead, and Chamelio. Experience using AI assistants, such as Claude, to accelerate operational workflows, including developing AI-powered skills, workflows, and dashboards. Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to share insights and recommendations effectively with cross-functional teams and commercial leadership. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving, data governance, and operational execution. Comfort working with ambiguity, managing changing priorities, and delivering results in a fast-paced, high-growth, global environment. A proactive, adaptable mindset, with a genuine interest in continuous learning, process optimization, and operational excellence. Ability to collaborate across functions and time zones, with flexibility to support a globally distributed team. Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance options.
