review_queue.title: Marketing Operations & AI Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Data quality and CRM management Maintain and optimize contact, account, and lead data across HubSpot and Salesforce. Identify the root causes of data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and incorrect field mappings, implementing sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues. Develop AI-powered workflows for data enrichment, deduplication, validation, and cleanup to reduce manual effort and improve data reliability. Marketing and campaign attribution Own campaign attribution from the first customer interaction through closed-won opportunities, ensuring accurate tracking across marketing activities. Maintain reliable campaign tracking processes that provide visibility into pipeline generation and marketing performance. Build and maintain reports that translate marketing data into actionable insights, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about resource allocation and campaign investments. Prospect list building and enrichment Build, maintain, and enrich targeted prospect lists using Clay and TitanX, aligned with the ideal customer profile (ICP) and strategic target accounts. Ensure prospect lists are accurate, relevant, deduplicated, and ready for sales outreach. Continuously improve list-building workflows to increase prospecting efficiency and data quality. Process improvement and AI automation Identify repetitive manual tasks and replace them with AI agents, automated workflows, custom assistants, or lightweight tools. Use AI technologies to streamline data management, research, analysis, list generation, and operational processes. Investigate problems independently, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements without waiting for detailed instructions. Document processes, CRM fields, workflow changes, and operating procedures, communicating updates clearly to relevant stakeholders. Business development operations Develop reports tracking business development representative (BDR) activity, including calls, emails, contact engagement, and outreach performance. Determine which prospect lists should be prioritized for outreach and load qualified contacts into appropriate Outreach sequences. Monitor BDR workloads, assigned tasks, and sequence capacity to ensure balanced workloads and effective prospect engagement. Identify and address operational issues early, including declining list availability, incomplete activities, underperforming sequences, and gaps in outreach execution. Collaborate with marketing and sales stakeholders to improve operational alignment, pipeline visibility, and overall revenue generation. Requirements: At least 3 years of experience in marketing operations, sales operations, or revenue operations within a B2B organization. A solid understanding of commercial objectives and the ability to connect operational reporting with business decisions, pipeline generation, and revenue outcomes. Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models, campaign tracking, and performance reporting. Proficiency in working with large datasets and spreadsheets, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data validation, and data cleanup. Experience supporting BDR or sales development representative (SDR) teams through reporting, prospect list building, contact enrichment, and outreach sequencing. Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement platforms, particularly HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach. Experience with Clay and TitanX is also relevant. review_queue.title: Product Enablement Specialist II
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Mobile App Lifecycle Management: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications throughout onboarding, development coordination, store submission, launch, and ongoing updates. App Store Submissions: Prepare, submit, and maintain applications on Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console, ensuring compliance with platform requirements and submission guidelines. Rejection Investigation and Resolution: Analyze app review rejections from Apple and Google, identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and coordinate resubmissions to minimize launch delays. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex issues involving developer accounts, app builds, metadata, configurations, permissions, certificates, provisioning, API keys, and submission workflows before escalating to Engineering. Proactive Blocker Management: Identify applications experiencing submission delays or stalled progress, determine the next required actions, and proactively coordinate solutions to keep projects moving. Customer Support and Escalation Management: Handle complex customer cases, conduct troubleshooting calls when necessary, and provide clear, practical guidance to customers and agency owners. Developer Account Guidance: Help agency owners navigate Apple Developer Program requirements, Google Play Console configurations, account verification, agreements, access permissions, and application transfers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, communicate relevant findings, validate fixes, and ensure that reported issues are resolved effectively. Mobile App Testing and Validation: Perform end-to-end testing of mobile app workflows and verify that technical fixes, configurations, and updates work as expected before proceeding with submissions or releases. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document recurring app rejection scenarios, troubleshooting procedures, and successful resolutions to improve internal knowledge resources and operational consistency. Team Enablement: Support Product Enablement Specialist I team members by answering process-related questions, sharing troubleshooting expertise, and helping them resolve application issues more efficiently. Operational Improvement: Identify recurring technical and operational challenges, recommend process improvements, and contribute to reducing repeated submission failures and unnecessary escalations. Performance and Reporting: Maintain accurate application records, monitor progress across assigned apps, prepare operational reports, and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs). Requirements: Professional Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, application support, or a related field. Apple App Ecosystem: Working knowledge of the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, iOS application submission procedures, and app review requirements. Google Play Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google Play Console, Android app submission processes, developer account management, and store compliance requirements. App Submission Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to investigate app review rejections, submission blockers, configuration problems, and account-related issues independently. Mobile Application Fundamentals: Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Notification Services: Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), or comparable mobile notification technologies. Developer Account Administration: Ability to manage account access, user permissions, agreements, verification requirements, and app transfers across Apple and Google platforms. Technical Investigation: Ability to diagnose build, configuration, access, and submission issues before escalating them to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON and configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Testing and Quality Assurance: Ability to validate technical fixes and conduct end-to-end testing to ensure mobile applications function correctly throughout critical workflows. Data Analysis and Reporting: Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions to complex problems. Customer Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable explanations for customers and non-technical stakeholders. Ownership and Independence: A proactive mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex issues with limited supervision. Organization and Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple applications and customer cases simultaneously, prioritize urgent blockers, and meet deadlines and SLA requirements. Collaboration and Mentoring: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with customers, agency owners, Product and Engineering teams, and junior specialists. Continuous Improvement: A willingness to document new findings, share knowledge, improve workflows, and help reduce recurring operational issues. Data Auditing and Quality Control: Conduct regular data audits, identify discrepancies or missing information, coordinate necessary corrections, and follow up on outstanding issues until they are resolved. ATS Administration: Support the administration and maintenance of the recruitment platform, including job postings, openings, templates, application forms, workflows, and other system configurations. Recruitment Process Management: Help develop, maintain, and document standardized recruitment processes and workflows, ensuring that recruiters and hiring teams follow established procedures consistently. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure required recruitment information is captured accurately and on time, supporting smooth execution throughout the hiring lifecycle. System Testing and Implementation: Assist with testing and implementing system enhancements, workflow changes, and new recruitment processes to ensure functionality, accuracy, and operational readiness. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve recruitment data quality, streamline administrative processes, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance the overall effectiveness of talent acquisition operations. Interview Scheduling Support: Provide interview coordination and scheduling assistance when required, based on team workload and operational coverage needs. Attention to Detail: A high level of accuracy and a disciplined approach to reviewing, validating, and double-checking information to maintain reliable recruitment records. Organizational Skills: Excellent time management and organizational abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent quality in a fast-paced environment. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, supported by professionalism, accountability, and the ability to collaborate effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, and other stakeholders. Process Improvement Mindset: An interest in identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, improve operational consistency, and make recruitment processes more efficient. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote work arrangements from India, offering flexibility in your working environment. Comprehensive Employee Benefits: Full-time employment benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance. Collaborative Work Environment: Work alongside recruiters, hiring teams, and cross-functional colleagues in an inclusive, team-oriented culture. Meaningful Responsibilities: Contribute directly to recruitment efficiency, data quality, and the hiring experience across US business teams. Continuous Improvement Opportunities: Gain practical experience supporting system enhancements, process optimization, and operational projects. Global Exposure: Develop experience collaborating with international stakeholders and supporting recruitment operations across different time zones. Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Ability to manage developer account access, permissions, agreements, verification processes, and application transfers. Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging, or comparable mobile notification technologies. Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Ability to investigate build, configuration, account, and submission issues independently before escalating to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON, configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting capabilities, and sound judgment when managing complex technical issues. Experience managing customer escalations and handling multiple applications or cases simultaneously with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical problems and solutions clearly to non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, organization, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills. review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Support the performance marketing team with day-to-day campaign reporting, data analysis, and paid media operations. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports across digital advertising channels, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads. Use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to organize, clean, analyze, and present campaign data. Monitor key marketing metrics, including advertising spend, impressions, clicks, click-through rates (CTR), cost per click (CPC), leads, conversions, and cost per acquisition (CPA). Maintain marketing dashboards, reporting spreadsheets, campaign trackers, and performance documentation. Assist with campaign quality assurance before and after launch by checking tracking links, landing pages, UTM parameters, creative assets, and campaign settings. Support campaign setup, monitoring, and performance reviews across paid media platforms. Identify basic trends, performance changes, and anomalies in campaign data, escalating findings when necessary. Assist with keyword, audience, competitor, and market research to support campaign planning and optimization. Review search terms, advertising placements, audience performance, and campaign-level reports under the guidance of experienced team members. Help maintain campaign naming conventions, tracking documentation, creative libraries, landing page links, and advertising assets. Document campaign changes, experiments, optimization activities, and key learnings to support continuous improvement. Use ChatGPT and other AI-powered tools to support research, reporting, documentation, campaign ideation, and workflow efficiency. Collaborate with creative, analytics, web, and marketing operations teams to coordinate tasks and support campaign execution. Communicate progress, priorities, questions, and potential blockers clearly while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Learn new marketing tools, advertising platforms, reporting processes, and customer acquisition strategies while contributing to ongoing team initiatives. Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed coursework in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. Demonstrated interest in performance marketing, digital advertising, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or customer acquisition. Basic understanding of digital marketing principles, the customer acquisition funnel, and common campaign performance metrics. Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, with the ability to organize and work with numerical data. Familiarity with spreadsheet formulas, filters, pivot tables, charts, reporting, or data visualization is an advantage. Exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, Google Analytics, or similar digital marketing platforms is beneficial but not mandatory. Basic understanding of UTM tracking, campaign URLs, landing pages, and conversion tracking is an advantage. Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, documentation, or productivity is preferred. Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to reviewing data, reports, and campaign configurations. A proactive, self-motivated attitude, with the initiative to find resources, learn independently, ask questions, and take accountability. Ability to follow instructions, document processes, incorporate feedback, and seek clarification when needed. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share findings and provide clear status updates. Good collaboration, time-management, and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Curiosity about digital advertising, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and data-driven marketing optimization. Willingness to learn new tools and processes, take on challenging assignments, and work collaboratively in a remote environment. Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM India Standard Time (IST). Benefits: Monthly stipend: ₹40,000 INR for the duration of the six-month apprenticeship. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with no requirement to work from a physical office. Practical industry experience: Gain hands-on exposure to paid media campaigns, performance reporting, campaign tracking, and digital marketing operations. Professional development: Learn from an experienced performance marketing team and develop practical skills in campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization. Technology exposure: Build familiarity with leading digital advertising platforms, spreadsheets, analytics tools, and AI-powered workflows. Portfolio-building opportunities: Develop transferable skills and practical experience that can support future career opportunities in digital marketing and analytics. Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and learn how different marketing functions contribute to campaign performance and business growth. Structured apprenticeship: Participate in a six-month learning experience designed to build foundational skills and prepare you for further growth in performance marketing. review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Develop, maintain, and validate clinical trial datasets using SAS and R programming to support clinical data analysis and reporting. Create, implement, and validate datasets in accordance with CDISC standards, particularly SDTM and ADaM. Generate and validate Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions. Perform programming validation, quality control checks, and discrepancy resolution to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of clinical data. Apply SAS macros, data manipulation techniques, and statistical programming methods to support clinical research deliverables. Ensure that programming activities comply with applicable clinical research standards, data quality expectations, and regulatory requirements. Maintain clear and accurate programming documentation, traceability, and validation records. Collaborate with biostatistics, clinical data management, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality clinical programming outputs on schedule. Requirements: A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in Clinical SAS Programming is required. At least 1 year of hands-on R Programming experience is mandatory. Candidates with SAS experience but without the required R programming experience will not be considered. A relevant Clinical SAS Programming certification is required. Strong practical knowledge of clinical trial data, including SDTM and ADaM standards and the development and validation of clinical datasets. Experience generating Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) and supporting clinical study reporting and regulatory submissions. Proficiency in SAS macros, data manipulation, statistical programming, programming validation, and quality control processes. A solid understanding of clinical research standards, regulatory requirements, and data quality practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, exceptional attention to detail, and effective written and verbal communication skills. The ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, manage programming deliverables, and maintain accurate technical documentation. Availability to join within a 30–60-day notice period is preferred. Benefits: Competitive annual salary: ₹12,00,000–₹20,00,000, depending on experience and suitability. Permanent, full-time employment offering the opportunity to contribute to clinical research and statistical programming projects. Fully remote work arrangement: Work from home from anywhere in India. Geographic flexibility: Open to eligible candidates across India, without the need to relocate to a specific office location. Technical growth: Opportunities to apply and strengthen expertise in Clinical SAS, R programming, clinical data standards, and regulatory programming workflows. Cross-functional collaboration: Work alongside professionals in biostatistics and clinical data management in a collaborative clinical research environment. review_queue.title: Project Analyst
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Financial Planning and Monitoring: Collaborate with project management teams to accurately record completed project activities, associated units, and financial values on a monthly basis. Revenue Forecasting: Develop and maintain forecasts for future project activities and revenue, ensuring financial projections reflect current project plans and expected deliverables. Budget and Profitability Analysis: Analyze actual hours, costs, revenue, and resource utilization against approved budgets to identify variances, assess profitability, and recommend corrective actions. Resource Planning: Review projected resource assignments to ensure staffing levels and resource allocations align with forecasted workloads and project requirements. Invoicing and Cash Flow Management: Ensure invoices are issued promptly when applicable and monitor overall project cash positions, including service revenue, payments, grants, outstanding invoices, advances, and other financial components. Financial Data Management: Maintain accurate, complete, and timely financial records in designated systems, ensuring data integrity and consistency across project reporting processes. Client Financial Reporting: Prepare and deliver accurate financial reports to clients within agreed timelines and in accordance with contractual obligations and client-specific requirements. Change Order Management: Support the change order process by documenting scope changes, reviewing revised budgets and payment schedules, and coordinating the necessary review and approval activities. Audit and Compliance Support: Ensure financial records meet audit requirements and assist with interim and year-end audit processes, maintaining appropriate documentation and supporting compliance activities. Revenue Recognition: Apply relevant revenue recognition principles, including percentage-of-completion methodologies, to support accurate financial reporting throughout the project lifecycle. Regulatory Awareness: Stay informed about applicable local and international revenue regulations and support the consistent application of relevant financial policies. Stakeholder Collaboration: Serve as a financial resource for project teams, helping colleagues understand financial performance, challenging assumptions when necessary, and escalating financial risks through appropriate channels. Financial Communication and Presentations: Develop clear financial summaries and presentations that explain project performance, risks, and forecasts to non-financial stakeholders and clients. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to assigned projects and areas of specialization, develop financial expertise through ongoing learning, and undertake additional responsibilities as required. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent four-year qualification in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, analyze budget variances, and draw actionable conclusions. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, analyze, and report financial information accurately. Understanding of project financial management throughout the complete project lifecycle, from initial study award and planning through execution and closeout. Familiarity with revenue recognition principles, particularly percentage-of-completion accounting, and their application to project financial reporting. Understanding of project budgets, cost tracking, revenue forecasting, resource planning, invoicing, and cash flow management. Ability to prepare financial reports and presentations and communicate complex financial information clearly to colleagues and clients without a finance background. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong English proficiency and the ability to present financial findings concisely and professionally. Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, address financial concerns, and support sound business decisions. High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records, meeting reporting deadlines, and complying with audit requirements. Ability to identify financial risks, prioritize competing responsibilities, and escalate issues through the appropriate channels. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with project managers, cross-functional teams, and external clients in a remote working environment. A proactive approach to professional development, with the ability to learn independently, adapt to evolving requirements, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Previous experience in finance, business analysis, project accounting, or a related field is preferred. Experience in clinical research or contract research organization (CRO) environments would be advantageous. Benefits: Remote work flexibility: Work remotely from India in a full-time position. Meaningful industry contribution: Support the financial management of clinical research projects that contribute to healthcare advancements and improved patient outcomes. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with project management teams and client stakeholders to support financial transparency and effective decision-making. Professional development: Strengthen your expertise in project finance, budgeting, revenue recognition, financial analysis, and client reporting. International exposure: Gain experience working with project financial processes, client requirements, and regulatory considerations in a global clinical research environment. Analytical and business impact: Contribute directly to project profitability, resource optimization, financial compliance, and operational efficiency. Inclusive work environment: Join a professional culture that values collaboration, diversity, equal opportunity, and continuous learning. Career progression: Opportunities for advancement may be available based on demonstrated competencies, increasing responsibility, and the ability to work independently rather than tenure alone. review_queue.title: Quality Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Maintain awareness of applicable GxP guidelines and regulatory requirements, ensuring that quality processes and service delivery activities remain compliant with established standards. Support and coordinate electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) activities, including change control, deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and effectiveness checks. Develop, recommend, monitor, and document deviations, quality events, and corrective and preventive actions, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis and effective resolution. Review, approve, and communicate root cause investigation findings and CAPA plans to relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear documentation and accountability. Conduct effectiveness checks to verify that corrective and preventive actions have addressed identified issues and reduced the likelihood of recurrence. Participate in GxP change management activities, including risk and impact assessments, change plan reviews and approvals, implementation monitoring, and tracking actions through completion. Coordinate client audits and regulatory inspections, including preparing agendas, organizing required documentation, arranging logistics, and ensuring relevant subject matter experts are available. Coordinate audit-related CAPA responses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to prepare accurate, comprehensive, and timely responses. Maintain audit and inspection records in the eQMS, ensuring that documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately stored, and tracked through closure. Generate quality reports and analyze data related to deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to quality systems, procedures, and operational processes. For medical information quality assurance activities, retrospectively evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to verify compliance with applicable procedures and quality standards. Collaborate with internal teams, quality stakeholders, and clients to support continuous improvement, strengthen compliance, and maintain high service quality. Undertake additional quality-related responsibilities as needed to support evolving business and operational requirements. Requirements A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in a suitable discipline is required. At least 2 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance role. Working knowledge of GxP quality management systems and the regulatory requirements applicable to quality-related activities. Experience with quality management processes, including deviations, quality events, CAPAs, effectiveness checks, and change control, is preferred. Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including quality record management, documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Strong understanding of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. Excellent organizational, prioritization, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage several activities and deadlines simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, internal teams, management, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong customer service skills and a collaborative approach to resolving quality issues and supporting internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining proactive, flexible, and responsive to changing priorities. A professional attitude, openness to change, and the ability to contribute positively to a diverse, collaborative, and quality-driven environment. Preferred: Experience conducting Medical Information Quality Assurance reviews, particularly evaluating recorded telephone calls and case reports in a call center environment. Benefits Flexible working arrangements: Remote working opportunities in India, with potential hybrid arrangements for employees located within a reasonable commuting distance of an office, as agreed with their manager. Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in quality assurance, GxP compliance, quality management systems, and regulatory processes. Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to support quality and compliance activities that contribute to reliable healthcare and pharmaceutical services. Collaborative environment: Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and clients on quality improvement initiatives. Continuous learning: Exposure to audits, regulatory inspections, quality investigations, and process improvement activities. Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where employees can contribute authentically and develop their skills. Career growth: Opportunities to expand quality assurance expertise and take on additional responsibilities as business needs evolve. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

review_queue.title: PPC Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: As a PPC Specialist, you will oversee the end-to-end management of paid media campaigns, combining strategic planning, hands-on execution, and performance optimization to achieve marketing and business goals. Campaign strategy and planning: Define campaign objectives, KPIs, audience targeting, budget allocations, and bidding strategies. Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Campaign setup and execution: Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and relevant social media platforms, including search, display, shopping, and remarketing campaigns. Ad creation and testing: Develop compelling ad copy, organize campaign structures, and test different creative variations, extensions, audiences, and messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates. Performance monitoring and optimization: Track key metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), impressions, and conversions. Adjust bids, budgets, and targeting based on performance insights. Conversion rate optimization: Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to improve landing pages, forms, messaging, and user journeys. Use analytics and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for higher conversion rates. Tracking and analytics: Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking, UTM parameters, advertising pixels, Google Analytics, and tag management systems to ensure reliable measurement and reporting. Reporting and insights: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports, analyze attribution and funnel performance, and present actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Cross-functional collaboration: Share performance insights and best practices across marketing channels, ensuring paid media activities align with SEO, content, and broader digital marketing initiatives. Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, including search, display, and remarketing campaigns. Experience with Google Analytics, tag management systems, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make evidence-based decisions. Excellent written communication and ad-copywriting skills, with an understanding of how messaging influences engagement and conversions. Familiarity with landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize competing tasks, and meet deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and present insights to stakeholders. Curiosity and adaptability, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with digital advertising developments. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, or other paid media platforms. Familiarity with e-commerce and shopping campaigns. Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordStream, Optimizely, or Unbounce. Exposure to automated bidding strategies, advertising scripts, or API-based campaign management. Knowledge of attribution models, multi-touch attribution, and advanced marketing analytics. Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications. human_review.title: Marketing Operations & AI Specialist
human_review.description: Accountabilities: Data quality and CRM management Maintain and optimize contact, account, and lead data across HubSpot and Salesforce. Identify the root causes of data inconsistencies, duplicate records, and incorrect field mappings, implementing sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues. Develop AI-powered workflows for data enrichment, deduplication, validation, and cleanup to reduce manual effort and improve data reliability. Marketing and campaign attribution Own campaign attribution from the first customer interaction through closed-won opportunities, ensuring accurate tracking across marketing activities. Maintain reliable campaign tracking processes that provide visibility into pipeline generation and marketing performance. Build and maintain reports that translate marketing data into actionable insights, helping stakeholders make informed decisions about resource allocation and campaign investments. Prospect list building and enrichment Build, maintain, and enrich targeted prospect lists using Clay and TitanX, aligned with the ideal customer profile (ICP) and strategic target accounts. Ensure prospect lists are accurate, relevant, deduplicated, and ready for sales outreach. Continuously improve list-building workflows to increase prospecting efficiency and data quality. Process improvement and AI automation Identify repetitive manual tasks and replace them with AI agents, automated workflows, custom assistants, or lightweight tools. Use AI technologies to streamline data management, research, analysis, list generation, and operational processes. Investigate problems independently, recommend practical solutions, and implement improvements without waiting for detailed instructions. Document processes, CRM fields, workflow changes, and operating procedures, communicating updates clearly to relevant stakeholders. Business development operations Develop reports tracking business development representative (BDR) activity, including calls, emails, contact engagement, and outreach performance. Determine which prospect lists should be prioritized for outreach and load qualified contacts into appropriate Outreach sequences. Monitor BDR workloads, assigned tasks, and sequence capacity to ensure balanced workloads and effective prospect engagement. Identify and address operational issues early, including declining list availability, incomplete activities, underperforming sequences, and gaps in outreach execution. Collaborate with marketing and sales stakeholders to improve operational alignment, pipeline visibility, and overall revenue generation. A solid understanding of commercial objectives and the ability to connect operational reporting with business decisions, pipeline generation, and revenue outcomes. Hands-on experience with marketing attribution models, campaign tracking, and performance reporting. Proficiency in working with large datasets and spreadsheets, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data validation, and data cleanup. Experience supporting BDR or sales development representative (SDR) teams through reporting, prospect list building, contact enrichment, and outreach sequencing. Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement platforms, particularly HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach. Experience with Clay and TitanX is also relevant. Practical experience using AI tools beyond basic conversational assistance, including building AI agents, custom assistants, automated workflows, or multi-step processes that improve operational efficiency. Ability to identify opportunities for automation, experiment with emerging AI tools, and implement solutions that eliminate repetitive manual work. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues independently, identify root causes, and recommend effective solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly when documenting processes, explaining workflow changes, and coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and deliver measurable results in a remote environment. Comfort working with a globally distributed team and maintaining consistent availability during U.S. Eastern business hours, Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. EST. human_review.title: Product Enablement Specialist II
human_review.description: Accountabilities:: Mobile App Lifecycle Management: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications throughout onboarding, development coordination, store submission, launch, and ongoing updates. App Store Submissions: Prepare, submit, and maintain applications on Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console, ensuring compliance with platform requirements and submission guidelines. Rejection Investigation and Resolution: Analyze app review rejections from Apple and Google, identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and coordinate resubmissions to minimize launch delays. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex issues involving developer accounts, app builds, metadata, configurations, permissions, certificates, provisioning, API keys, and submission workflows before escalating to Engineering. Proactive Blocker Management: Identify applications experiencing submission delays or stalled progress, determine the next required actions, and proactively coordinate solutions to keep projects moving. Customer Support and Escalation Management: Handle complex customer cases, conduct troubleshooting calls when necessary, and provide clear, practical guidance to customers and agency owners. Developer Account Guidance: Help agency owners navigate Apple Developer Program requirements, Google Play Console configurations, account verification, agreements, access permissions, and application transfers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, communicate relevant findings, validate fixes, and ensure that reported issues are resolved effectively. Mobile App Testing and Validation: Perform end-to-end testing of mobile app workflows and verify that technical fixes, configurations, and updates work as expected before proceeding with submissions or releases. Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document recurring app rejection scenarios, troubleshooting procedures, and successful resolutions to improve internal knowledge resources and operational consistency. Team Enablement: Support Product Enablement Specialist I team members by answering process-related questions, sharing troubleshooting expertise, and helping them resolve application issues more efficiently. Operational Improvement: Identify recurring technical and operational challenges, recommend process improvements, and contribute to reducing repeated submission failures and unnecessary escalations. Performance and Reporting: Maintain accurate application records, monitor progress across assigned apps, prepare operational reports, and ensure compliance with established service-level agreements (SLAs). Requirements: Professional Experience: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, application support, or a related field. Apple App Ecosystem: Working knowledge of the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, iOS application submission procedures, and app review requirements. Google Play Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google Play Console, Android app submission processes, developer account management, and store compliance requirements. App Submission Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to investigate app review rejections, submission blockers, configuration problems, and account-related issues independently. Mobile Application Fundamentals: Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Notification Services: Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), or comparable mobile notification technologies. Developer Account Administration: Ability to manage account access, user permissions, agreements, verification requirements, and app transfers across Apple and Google platforms. Technical Investigation: Ability to diagnose build, configuration, access, and submission issues before escalating them to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON and configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Testing and Quality Assurance: Ability to validate technical fixes and conduct end-to-end testing to ensure mobile applications function correctly throughout critical workflows. Data Analysis and Reporting: Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong troubleshooting capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to identify root causes and develop effective solutions to complex problems. Customer Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear, actionable explanations for customers and non-technical stakeholders. Ownership and Independence: A proactive mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to investigate and resolve complex issues with limited supervision. Organization and Prioritization: Ability to manage multiple applications and customer cases simultaneously, prioritize urgent blockers, and meet deadlines and SLA requirements. Collaboration and Mentoring: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with customers, agency owners, Product and Engineering teams, and junior specialists. Continuous Improvement: A willingness to document new findings, share knowledge, improve workflows, and help reduce recurring operational issues. Preferred Experience: Previous experience with a SaaS or CRM platform, particularly white-label mobile app solutions, is beneficial. Familiarity with AI-powered productivity tools is also an advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility of a distributed working environment. Career Development: Build specialized expertise in mobile app publishing, technical troubleshooting, SaaS operations, and product enablement. Technical Growth: Gain hands-on experience with Apple and Google developer ecosystems, mobile application configurations, notification services, and app lifecycle management. Increased Ownership: Independently manage complex application portfolios and take responsibility for technical problem-solving and customer outcomes. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and improve application workflows. Knowledge Sharing: Develop leadership skills by mentoring junior specialists and contributing to internal documentation and process improvements. Manage requests from internal Data teams that require client communication or action to investigate and resolve data verification issues. Investigate client-reported bugs, data discrepancies, and processing problems, escalating technical issues to Product and Engineering teams when necessary. Collaborate with Account Managers, Solutions Architects, and go-to-market stakeholders to coordinate data-related escalations and achieve positive client outcomes. Communicate clearly with clients, data providers, and internal teams to gather information, clarify issues, and keep relevant stakeholders informed. Contribute to cross-functional projects that improve internal workflows, strengthen data management processes, and support the introduction of new product features and services. Maintain accurate documentation of team processes, recurring issues, and troubleshooting procedures. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the overall client support experience. human_review.description: Accountabilities: Independently manage a portfolio of white-label mobile applications from onboarding through launch, submission, and ongoing maintenance. Prepare, submit, and manage applications across the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, ensuring compliance with platform requirements. Investigate and resolve application rejections, submission blockers, developer account issues, build failures, metadata problems, configuration errors, and access-related challenges. Identify applications experiencing delays or stalled progress and proactively determine the appropriate next steps to move them forward. Handle complex customer cases and lead troubleshooting calls when necessary, translating technical issues into clear and actionable guidance. Guide agency owners through Apple Developer and Google Play Console requirements, including account setup, permissions, agreements, verification, and app transfers. Coordinate technical escalations with Product and Engineering teams, providing relevant diagnostic information and validating solutions before closing issues. Document new rejection scenarios, troubleshooting methods, and successful resolutions to strengthen team knowledge and consistency. Support Product Enablement Specialist I colleagues by answering process questions and sharing technical troubleshooting expertise. Identify recurring operational challenges and recommend improvements to workflows, documentation, and submission processes. Maintain service-level agreement (SLA) compliance, accurate application tracking, and reliable reporting across the assigned portfolio. Perform end-to-end testing of mobile application workflows and verify fixes to ensure successful outcomes. Requirements: Typically 2–4 years of experience in SaaS, technical support, product operations, product enablement, or a related technical or customer-facing role. Working knowledge of Apple Developer, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and iOS and Android application submission processes. Experience troubleshooting application review rejections, submission failures, and related technical blockers. Understanding of Bundle IDs, App IDs, certificates, provisioning concepts, API keys, and push notification configuration. Ability to manage developer account access, permissions, agreements, verification processes, and application transfers. Working knowledge of Apple Push Notification service (APNs), Firebase Cloud Messaging, or comparable mobile notification technologies. Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, and reporting. Ability to investigate build, configuration, account, and submission issues independently before escalating to Engineering. Familiarity with APIs, JSON, configuration files, browser developer tools, or similar technical concepts is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting capabilities, and sound judgment when managing complex technical issues. Experience managing customer escalations and handling multiple applications or cases simultaneously with minimal supervision. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical problems and solutions clearly to non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, organization, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Familiarity with the Apple Developer Program, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, app review management, or SaaS and CRM platforms is preferred. Experience with HighLevel or similar platforms, as well as AI-powered productivity tools, is an added advantage. Benefits: Remote work arrangement within India. Opportunity to develop expertise in mobile application publishing, platform compliance, and technical troubleshooting across iOS and Android. Exposure to SaaS product operations and collaboration with Product and Engineering teams. Opportunities to contribute to operational improvements, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. human_review.title: Associate, Talent Acquisition Operations
human_review.description: Accountabilities:: Recruitment Data Management: Maintain accurate and complete candidate, job, and recruitment records within the applicant tracking system (ATS), regularly reviewing information to ensure data integrity and consistency. Reporting and Analytics: Create, update, and maintain recurring and ad hoc recruitment reports to track key hiring metrics, provide operational insights, and support informed decision-making by talent acquisition teams and business stakeholders. Data Auditing and Quality Control: Conduct regular data audits, identify discrepancies or missing information, coordinate necessary corrections, and follow up on outstanding issues until they are resolved. ATS Administration: Support the administration and maintenance of the recruitment platform, including job postings, openings, templates, application forms, workflows, and other system configurations. Recruitment Process Management: Help develop, maintain, and document standardized recruitment processes and workflows, ensuring that recruiters and hiring teams follow established procedures consistently. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure required recruitment information is captured accurately and on time, supporting smooth execution throughout the hiring lifecycle. System Testing and Implementation: Assist with testing and implementing system enhancements, workflow changes, and new recruitment processes to ensure functionality, accuracy, and operational readiness. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve recruitment data quality, streamline administrative processes, reduce inefficiencies, and enhance the overall effectiveness of talent acquisition operations. Interview Scheduling Support: Provide interview coordination and scheduling assistance when required, based on team workload and operational coverage needs. Project and Program Support: Contribute to recruitment-related projects, talent acquisition programs, and cross-functional initiatives that support business growth and operational excellence. Global Team Coordination: Maintain effective communication with US-based colleagues and other stakeholders, ensuring timely follow-ups, accurate information sharing, and continuity of recruiting operations across time zones. Requirements: Professional Experience: 2–3 years of experience in talent acquisition operations, recruiting operations, HR operations, or a similar administrative or operational role. Applicant Tracking Systems: Hands-on experience using an applicant tracking system, including maintaining recruitment data, supporting workflows, and ensuring data accuracy. Experience with Ashby is strongly preferred. Recruitment Reporting: Experience creating and maintaining recruitment reports, tracking key performance indicators, and working with hiring data to support operational decisions. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams, with the ability to manage data, prepare reports, and coordinate effectively with stakeholders. Attention to Detail: A high level of accuracy and a disciplined approach to reviewing, validating, and double-checking information to maintain reliable recruitment records. Organizational Skills: Excellent time management and organizational abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent quality in a fast-paced environment. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, supported by professionalism, accountability, and the ability to collaborate effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, and other stakeholders. Problem-Solving Ability: A proactive approach to identifying inconsistencies, investigating issues, following up on outstanding tasks, and taking ownership of resolutions. Adaptability: The ability to navigate ambiguity, learn new systems quickly, and bring structure to evolving workflows, processes, and priorities. Cross-Cultural Collaboration: Comfort working with US-based teams and global stakeholders across different time zones, with a willingness to maintain an ongoing evening or overnight schedule aligned with US business hours. Process Improvement Mindset: An interest in identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, improve operational consistency, and make recruitment processes more efficient. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote work arrangements from India, offering flexibility in your working environment. Comprehensive Employee Benefits: Full-time employment benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance. Retirement Benefits: Access to a 401(k) retirement savings plan with an employer matching contribution, subject to applicable plan terms. Paid Time Off: Paid leave to support personal needs, rest, and work-life balance. Professional Development: Opportunities to expand your expertise in talent acquisition operations, recruitment systems, reporting, and HR technology. Collaborative Work Environment: Work alongside recruiters, hiring teams, and cross-functional colleagues in an inclusive, team-oriented culture. Meaningful Responsibilities: Contribute directly to recruitment efficiency, data quality, and the hiring experience across US business teams. Continuous Improvement Opportunities: Gain practical experience supporting system enhancements, process optimization, and operational projects. Global Exposure: Develop experience collaborating with international stakeholders and supporting recruitment operations across different time zones. Growth and Mentorship: Benefit from a professional environment that values accountability, teamwork, leadership, excellence, and ongoing learning. Predictable Team Coverage: Work within an established schedule aligned with US business hours, with exact start and end times determined by team coverage needs. Important scheduling note: This position requires a consistent evening or overnight schedule in India to support US teams, with coverage extending to at least 2:00 PM Pacific Time / 5:00 PM Eastern Time. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Perform quality assurance checks on digital products and multilingual metadata by accurately following testing instructions, test cases, and established review procedures. Evaluate written and spoken content to ensure linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, consistency, and suitability for the intended target market. Review and validate metadata and content associated with music, television, and other digital entertainment applications. Identify, document, and report linguistic errors, inconsistencies, data quality issues, and deviations from project requirements. Follow project-specific quality standards, brand guidelines, trademark requirements, style guides, glossaries, and client-approved checklists. Complete assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines while maintaining consistently high quality standards. Use spreadsheets and relevant tools to organize, analyze, validate, and manage metadata and quality assurance findings. Collaborate with international teams to monitor and improve product quality, localization accuracy, and the reliability of partner data integrations. Prioritize tasks and issues effectively, adapt to changing requirements, and make informed decisions when working with ambiguous or incomplete information. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of language usage, cultural nuances, technical terminology, and regional conventions in the assigned language. Demonstrate consistency, focus, and motivation when performing repetitive review and testing tasks in a fast-paced production environment. Handle potentially sensitive or offensive content professionally, including material relating to sexuality, health, race, or violence, in accordance with project guidelines. Requirements: Native-level fluency in at least one of the following languages: German, French, Norwegian, Swedish, Mexican Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, or Russian. Up-to-date familiarity with current technical terminology and common language usage in the target locale. Strong linguistic skills, including excellent written communication, attention to grammar and style, and an understanding of cultural context. Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, consistent, and high-quality work. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing tasks and meet deadlines. Ability to remain productive and motivated while completing repetitive, detail-intensive assignments. Sound analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, interpret instructions, and make reasoned judgments. Effective verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate with geographically distributed teams. Flexibility and adaptability when working in a fast-paced environment with evolving project requirements and procedures. An interest in film, television, music, and digital entertainment, with relevant industry knowledge considered an advantage. Ability to work at a computer for extended periods, including prolonged sitting, keyboard use, mouse operation, and screen-based review. Willingness to review potentially sensitive or offensive content as part of assigned quality assurance responsibilities. Full-time position: Contribute to ongoing multilingual content quality and digital product improvement initiatives. Global collaboration: Work with international colleagues and contribute to products and services used across multiple markets. Linguistic and technical development: Apply your language expertise while strengthening your skills in metadata validation, quality assurance, data analysis, and localization. Digital entertainment exposure: Gain experience reviewing content and metadata related to music, television, and consumer technology services. Structured quality processes: Develop practical experience with testing methodologies, quality standards, localization guidelines, and content review workflows. Professional growth: Build transferable skills in data quality, linguistic evaluation, and digital content operations. verification_backlog.title: Performance Marketing Apprentice
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Support the performance marketing team with day-to-day campaign reporting, data analysis, and paid media operations. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports across digital advertising channels, including Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Ads. Use Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets to organize, clean, analyze, and present campaign data. Monitor key marketing metrics, including advertising spend, impressions, clicks, click-through rates (CTR), cost per click (CPC), leads, conversions, and cost per acquisition (CPA). Maintain marketing dashboards, reporting spreadsheets, campaign trackers, and performance documentation. Assist with campaign quality assurance before and after launch by checking tracking links, landing pages, UTM parameters, creative assets, and campaign settings. Support campaign setup, monitoring, and performance reviews across paid media platforms. Identify basic trends, performance changes, and anomalies in campaign data, escalating findings when necessary. Assist with keyword, audience, competitor, and market research to support campaign planning and optimization. Review search terms, advertising placements, audience performance, and campaign-level reports under the guidance of experienced team members. Help maintain campaign naming conventions, tracking documentation, creative libraries, landing page links, and advertising assets. Document campaign changes, experiments, optimization activities, and key learnings to support continuous improvement. Use ChatGPT and other AI-powered tools to support research, reporting, documentation, campaign ideation, and workflow efficiency. Collaborate with creative, analytics, web, and marketing operations teams to coordinate tasks and support campaign execution. Communicate progress, priorities, questions, and potential blockers clearly while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Learn new marketing tools, advertising platforms, reporting processes, and customer acquisition strategies while contributing to ongoing team initiatives. Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed coursework in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. Demonstrated interest in performance marketing, digital advertising, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or customer acquisition. Basic understanding of digital marketing principles, the customer acquisition funnel, and common campaign performance metrics. Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets, with the ability to organize and work with numerical data. Familiarity with spreadsheet formulas, filters, pivot tables, charts, reporting, or data visualization is an advantage. Exposure to Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, Google Analytics, or similar digital marketing platforms is beneficial but not mandatory. Basic understanding of UTM tracking, campaign URLs, landing pages, and conversion tracking is an advantage. Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools for research, analysis, reporting, documentation, or productivity is preferred. Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to reviewing data, reports, and campaign configurations. A proactive, self-motivated attitude, with the initiative to find resources, learn independently, ask questions, and take accountability. Ability to follow instructions, document processes, incorporate feedback, and seek clarification when needed. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to share findings and provide clear status updates. Good collaboration, time-management, and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Curiosity about digital advertising, analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and data-driven marketing optimization. Willingness to learn new tools and processes, take on challenging assignments, and work collaboratively in a remote environment. Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM India Standard Time (IST). Benefits: Monthly stipend: ₹40,000 INR for the duration of the six-month apprenticeship. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with no requirement to work from a physical office. Practical industry experience: Gain hands-on exposure to paid media campaigns, performance reporting, campaign tracking, and digital marketing operations. Professional development: Learn from an experienced performance marketing team and develop practical skills in campaign analysis, reporting, and optimization. Technology exposure: Build familiarity with leading digital advertising platforms, spreadsheets, analytics tools, and AI-powered workflows. Portfolio-building opportunities: Develop transferable skills and practical experience that can support future career opportunities in digital marketing and analytics. Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and learn how different marketing functions contribute to campaign performance and business growth. verification_backlog.title: Project Analyst
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Financial Planning and Monitoring: Collaborate with project management teams to accurately record completed project activities, associated units, and financial values on a monthly basis. Revenue Forecasting: Develop and maintain forecasts for future project activities and revenue, ensuring financial projections reflect current project plans and expected deliverables. Budget and Profitability Analysis: Analyze actual hours, costs, revenue, and resource utilization against approved budgets to identify variances, assess profitability, and recommend corrective actions. Resource Planning: Review projected resource assignments to ensure staffing levels and resource allocations align with forecasted workloads and project requirements. Invoicing and Cash Flow Management: Ensure invoices are issued promptly when applicable and monitor overall project cash positions, including service revenue, payments, grants, outstanding invoices, advances, and other financial components. Financial Data Management: Maintain accurate, complete, and timely financial records in designated systems, ensuring data integrity and consistency across project reporting processes. Client Financial Reporting: Prepare and deliver accurate financial reports to clients within agreed timelines and in accordance with contractual obligations and client-specific requirements. Change Order Management: Support the change order process by documenting scope changes, reviewing revised budgets and payment schedules, and coordinating the necessary review and approval activities. Audit and Compliance Support: Ensure financial records meet audit requirements and assist with interim and year-end audit processes, maintaining appropriate documentation and supporting compliance activities. Revenue Recognition: Apply relevant revenue recognition principles, including percentage-of-completion methodologies, to support accurate financial reporting throughout the project lifecycle. Regulatory Awareness: Stay informed about applicable local and international revenue regulations and support the consistent application of relevant financial policies. Stakeholder Collaboration: Serve as a financial resource for project teams, helping colleagues understand financial performance, challenging assumptions when necessary, and escalating financial risks through appropriate channels. Financial Communication and Presentations: Develop clear financial summaries and presentations that explain project performance, risks, and forecasts to non-financial stakeholders and clients. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to assigned projects and areas of specialization, develop financial expertise through ongoing learning, and undertake additional responsibilities as required. Requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent four-year qualification in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, analyze budget variances, and draw actionable conclusions. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to organize, analyze, and report financial information accurately. Understanding of project financial management throughout the complete project lifecycle, from initial study award and planning through execution and closeout. Familiarity with revenue recognition principles, particularly percentage-of-completion accounting, and their application to project financial reporting. Understanding of project budgets, cost tracking, revenue forecasting, resource planning, invoicing, and cash flow management. Ability to prepare financial reports and presentations and communicate complex financial information clearly to colleagues and clients without a finance background. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong English proficiency and the ability to present financial findings concisely and professionally. Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively, address financial concerns, and support sound business decisions. High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records, meeting reporting deadlines, and complying with audit requirements. Ability to identify financial risks, prioritize competing responsibilities, and escalate issues through the appropriate channels. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with project managers, cross-functional teams, and external clients in a remote working environment. A proactive approach to professional development, with the ability to learn independently, adapt to evolving requirements, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities. Previous experience in finance, business analysis, project accounting, or a related field is preferred. Experience in clinical research or contract research organization (CRO) environments would be advantageous. Benefits: Remote work flexibility: Work remotely from India in a full-time position. Meaningful industry contribution: Support the financial management of clinical research projects that contribute to healthcare advancements and improved patient outcomes. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with project management teams and client stakeholders to support financial transparency and effective decision-making. Professional development: Strengthen your expertise in project finance, budgeting, revenue recognition, financial analysis, and client reporting. International exposure: Gain experience working with project financial processes, client requirements, and regulatory considerations in a global clinical research environment. Analytical and business impact: Contribute directly to project profitability, resource optimization, financial compliance, and operational efficiency. Inclusive work environment: Join a professional culture that values collaboration, diversity, equal opportunity, and continuous learning.
