verification_backlog.title: Quality Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Maintain awareness of applicable GxP guidelines and regulatory requirements, ensuring that quality processes and service delivery activities remain compliant with established standards. Support and coordinate electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) activities, including change control, deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and effectiveness checks. Develop, recommend, monitor, and document deviations, quality events, and corrective and preventive actions, ensuring appropriate root cause analysis and effective resolution. Review, approve, and communicate root cause investigation findings and CAPA plans to relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear documentation and accountability. Conduct effectiveness checks to verify that corrective and preventive actions have addressed identified issues and reduced the likelihood of recurrence. Participate in GxP change management activities, including risk and impact assessments, change plan reviews and approvals, implementation monitoring, and tracking actions through completion. Coordinate client audits and regulatory inspections, including preparing agendas, organizing required documentation, arranging logistics, and ensuring relevant subject matter experts are available. Coordinate audit-related CAPA responses, collaborating with internal stakeholders to prepare accurate, comprehensive, and timely responses. Maintain audit and inspection records in the eQMS, ensuring that documentation is complete, accurate, appropriately stored, and tracked through closure. Generate quality reports and analyze data related to deviations, quality events, CAPAs, and key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to quality systems, procedures, and operational processes. For medical information quality assurance activities, retrospectively evaluate telephone interactions and case reports to verify compliance with applicable procedures and quality standards. Collaborate with internal teams, quality stakeholders, and clients to support continuous improvement, strengthen compliance, and maintain high service quality. Undertake additional quality-related responsibilities as needed to support evolving business and operational requirements. Requirements A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience in a suitable discipline is required. At least 2 years of professional experience in a Quality Assurance role. Working knowledge of GxP quality management systems and the regulatory requirements applicable to quality-related activities. Experience with quality management processes, including deviations, quality events, CAPAs, effectiveness checks, and change control, is preferred. Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including quality record management, documentation, reporting, and data analysis. Strong understanding of root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, risk assessment, and continuous improvement methodologies. Excellent organizational, prioritization, project management, and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage several activities and deadlines simultaneously. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, documentation quality, and regulatory compliance. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, internal teams, management, and cross-functional stakeholders. Strong customer service skills and a collaborative approach to resolving quality issues and supporting internal and external stakeholders. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining proactive, flexible, and responsive to changing priorities. A professional attitude, openness to change, and the ability to contribute positively to a diverse, collaborative, and quality-driven environment. Preferred: Experience conducting Medical Information Quality Assurance reviews, particularly evaluating recorded telephone calls and case reports in a call center environment. Benefits Flexible working arrangements: Remote working opportunities in India, with potential hybrid arrangements for employees located within a reasonable commuting distance of an office, as agreed with their manager. Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen expertise in quality assurance, GxP compliance, quality management systems, and regulatory processes. Meaningful contribution: The opportunity to support quality and compliance activities that contribute to reliable healthcare and pharmaceutical services. Collaborative environment: Opportunities to work with cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and clients on quality improvement initiatives. Continuous learning: Exposure to audits, regulatory inspections, quality investigations, and process improvement activities. Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and creating an environment where employees can contribute authentically and develop their skills. Career growth: Opportunities to expand quality assurance expertise and take on additional responsibilities as business needs evolve. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? verification_backlog.title: PPC Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: As a PPC Specialist, you will oversee the end-to-end management of paid media campaigns, combining strategic planning, hands-on execution, and performance optimization to achieve marketing and business goals. Campaign strategy and planning: Define campaign objectives, KPIs, audience targeting, budget allocations, and bidding strategies. Conduct keyword research, competitive analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Campaign setup and execution: Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and relevant social media platforms, including search, display, shopping, and remarketing campaigns. Ad creation and testing: Develop compelling ad copy, organize campaign structures, and test different creative variations, extensions, audiences, and messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates. Performance monitoring and optimization: Track key metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), impressions, and conversions. Adjust bids, budgets, and targeting based on performance insights. Conversion rate optimization: Collaborate with content, design, and development teams to improve landing pages, forms, messaging, and user journeys. Use analytics and behavioral insights to identify opportunities for higher conversion rates. Tracking and analytics: Implement and maintain accurate conversion tracking, UTM parameters, advertising pixels, Google Analytics, and tag management systems to ensure reliable measurement and reporting. Reporting and insights: Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports, analyze attribution and funnel performance, and present actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders. Budget management and forecasting: Monitor advertising spend, maintain budget pacing, and forecast traffic, leads, conversions, and ROI using historical data and market trends. Cross-functional collaboration: Share performance insights and best practices across marketing channels, ensuring paid media activities align with SEO, content, and broader digital marketing initiatives. Continuous improvement: Stay informed about advertising platform updates, industry trends, and emerging technologies. Test new channels, formats, tools, and automation opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scalability. Requirements We are looking for an analytical, proactive, and results-oriented digital marketing professional with hands-on PPC experience, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to translate campaign data into effective optimization strategies. A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing PPC and paid media campaigns. Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, including search, display, and remarketing campaigns. Experience with Google Analytics, tag management systems, conversion tracking, and campaign measurement. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and make evidence-based decisions. Excellent written communication and ad-copywriting skills, with an understanding of how messaging influences engagement and conversions. Familiarity with landing page optimization, A/B testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, prioritize competing tasks, and meet deadlines. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams and present insights to stakeholders. Curiosity and adaptability, with a commitment to continuous learning and staying current with digital advertising developments. Preferred qualifications: Experience with Microsoft Advertising, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, or other paid media platforms. Familiarity with e-commerce and shopping campaigns. Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, WordStream, Optimizely, or Unbounce. Exposure to automated bidding strategies, advertising scripts, or API-based campaign management. Knowledge of attribution models, multi-touch attribution, and advanced marketing analytics. Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications. Benefits 100% remote work: Work from anywhere, subject to the role's location requirements. Competitive salary: Receive a competitive compensation package. Inclusive work environment: Join a supportive workplace that values diverse perspectives and collaboration. Career growth opportunities: Develop your expertise and progress professionally within digital marketing. Professional development: Expand your knowledge of advertising platforms, analytics, and performance optimization. Collaborative team culture: Work alongside professionals across performance marketing, content, analytics, and other digital functions. Full-time opportunity: Enjoy a dedicated role with opportunities to contribute to ongoing marketing initiatives and long-term growth. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1
